notes: Direct HTTP fetch worked with no blocking (HTTP 200 on robots.txt, homepage https://www.homesrus.ae/en/, HTML sitemap page, XML sitemap index and both sub-sitemaps). robots.txt has only generic '*' groups, no Claude-specific disallow. Site is a Magento-based UAE home-furnishings retailer (Lals Group / Homes r Us). Absence proof for Pet Care per Section 4 rule: (1) full top-nav/mega-menu link inventory extracted from homepage HTML (~350 unique /en/ hrefs) covering Furniture, Decor & Furnishings (lighting, home accessories, home fragrance, garden, curtains-blinds, floor coverings, throws-cushions, wall-decor), Bath & Laundry, Bedding, Kitchen & Dining / Kitchen & Tableware, Wall Decor & Mirrors, Gifting Idea, Baby & Kids furniture - no Pets/Pet Care/Dog/Cat node anywhere in this list; (2) dedicated HTML sitemap page (https://www.homesrus.ae/en/homesrus-uae-english-sitemap/, 847 links) - no pet category link; (3) full XML sitemap (sitemap-1-1.xml + sitemap-1-2.xml, 9023 URLs covering every category and product page on the site) grepped case-insensitively for 'pet' - the only hits are false positives (petal, petite, 'Pete' [a lamp model name], appetizer, PET-plastic storage box, room-spray 'petal') - zero URLs matching /pet/, /pets/, /pet-care/, /dog/, /cat- as a category path. (4) Site search for 'pet' (catalogsearch/result) returns a client-rendered SPA shell with no server-side product/category data in the raw HTML (Magento PWA loaderType 'spa'), so it could not be used as either positive or negative evidence and was not relied upon per the 'zero-result site search is not proof' rule - the sitemap/nav check above is the actual absence proof. Conclusion: Home R Us UAE (homesrus.ae) does not carry a Pet Care category/vertical at all - it is a furniture/home-furnishings/kitchen/bath retailer with no pet products division. No rows to emit.
